description: Bounds operator_identity. Previously RealHumanApprovalAdmissionRecord.operator_identity was a free string — a free-string-only identity (without a signing-key reference or a payload-hash binding) was sufficient. This lock introduces BoundedOperatorIdentity (operator_id, display_name, signing_key_ref, timestamp, workspace_identity_hash, approval_payload_hash) and a check function that requires: (1) admission accepted, not fixture, signature_kind real_local_hmac; (2) bound is well-formed (bounded operator_id length, no NUL, 64-hex signing_key_ref/workspace_hash/payload_hash); (3) bound.operator_id matches admission.operator_identity; (4) bound.workspace_identity_hash matches sha256(admission.workspace_identity); (5) bound.approval_payload_hash matches the recomputed canonical payload hash. The lock NEVER opens source mutation — it only attests that a named operator is coupled to a specific admission packet. A free-string-only identity is refused with OPERATOR_IDENTITY_BLOCKED_FREE_STRING_ONLY.
